meta.title: Headmaster product demo, 60 s
meta.narrativeStructure: problem-solution (small problem: a task you would rather hand off)
meta.direction: Product stage: real app screens as the hero on a calm Studio set, Supademo-style guided zooms and cursor, kinetic Archivo line per scene, simple flat human moment in scene 1.

voice.note: No TTS here; owner adds ElevenLabs takes later. Subtitles burned in.

scenes.purpose: Show the product in frame 1 and say the whole promise: you ask in plain words.
scenes.voiceover: Say you need a hotel. You just ask.
scenes.layout: Left column: title. Right: a person on a sofa holds a phone; the phone shows the green chat with Headmaster. The request types in and sends; the reply says it is on it.
scenes.elements: Left column: title. Right: a person on a sofa holds a phone; the phone shows the green chat with Headmaster. The request types in and sends; the reply says it is on it.
scenes.animation: Title lines rise 40px out of a mask with blur 10 to 0 over 0.6s, 0.12s stagger. Text types at 28 chars/s, send tap ripples, bubble springs up 24px. Phone floats 5px on a 3.2s sine, hands follow.
scenes.camera: Static wide to 4.3s, then a 2.7s ease-in-out push to 2.1x on the thread; the title slides left 1.6x faster (parallax).
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
scenes.transitionOut: The push lands on the phone screen, which becomes the laptop chat window of scene 2 (match cut on the same thread and bubble).

scenes.purpose: Prove it does real work on its own computer.
scenes.voiceover: It has its own private computer. It searches, compares, and finds the booking page.
scenes.onScreenText: It works on its own computer.
scenes.layout: Real chat window, wide. A task panel on the right lists steps: Searching 14 hotels, Comparing prices, Opening the booking page. Mini browser view shows result cards.
scenes.elements: Real chat window, wide. A task panel on the right lists steps: Searching 14 hotels, Comparing prices, Opening the booking page. Mini browser view shows result cards.
scenes.animation: Steps tick in sequence at 1.4s intervals; result cards fan out from a stack (fan/spread) with 90ms stagger; spinner becomes a check with a 0.3s spring.
scenes.camera: Guided zoom 1.6x onto the task panel at 10s, cursor hotspot on the active step, callout 'Step 2 of 3'.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
scenes.transitionOut: Pan right along the thread to the approval card.

scenes.purpose: Hero moment: it asks before it spends.
scenes.voiceover: Before it spends a single euro, it asks you. Approve once, always allow, or say no.
scenes.layout: Approval card 'Pay 328 euros?' with Approve once, Always allow, Deny; the screen is dimmed 28% outside the card.
scenes.elements: Approval card 'Pay 328 euros?' with Approve once, Always allow, Deny; the screen is dimmed 28% outside the card.
scenes.animation: Cursor curves in, beacon pulses, click ripple, card flips to Booked with a spring check, border flashes blue for 4 frames.
scenes.camera: Supademo zoom 1.35x to the card, ease-heavy 1.1s; holds; zooms out after the click.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
scenes.transitionOut: Confirmation row slides into Files in the sidebar; camera follows to the Memory page.

scenes.purpose: Memory: less to explain each time.
scenes.voiceover: It remembers how you like things. So next time, just say: book the usual.
scenes.layout: Memory page list: Small hotels, Window seat, Under 180 euros. Composer types 'Book the usual.'
scenes.elements: Memory page list: Small hotels, Window seat, Under 180 euros. Composer types 'Book the usual.'
scenes.animation: List rows enter from the left as a staggered cascade (100ms); matching words in the composer highlight blue as each row is read.
scenes.camera: Slow 6 percent drift right to left; no zoom.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
scenes.transitionOut: Slide-wipe to a row of devices.

scenes.purpose: Same agent in chat apps, laptop, browser and phone.
scenes.voiceover: Use it in the chat apps you already use, or on your laptop, browser and phone.
scenes.layout: Four surfaces on a shared stage in a row: green chat first (phone), laptop app, browser tab, phone app. One thread shown on each.
scenes.elements: Four surfaces on a shared stage in a row: green chat first (phone), laptop app, browser tab, phone app. One thread shown on each.
scenes.animation: Parallax layers pan: devices slide at 0.6x/1x/1.4x speeds; each surface lights (white fill vs lavender) as it is named.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
scenes.transitionOut: Camera dips into dark for night (hard cut justified by time passing: clock 23:40).

scenes.voiceover: Give it jobs before bed. It works through them overnight, and tells you in the morning.
scenes.layout: Dark board (To do, Doing, Done) at night with a clock 23:40, then the bedside phone at 07:30 with a green chat message '3 jobs done overnight'.
scenes.elements: Dark board (To do, Doing, Done) at night with a clock 23:40, then the bedside phone at 07:30 with a green chat message '3 jobs done overnight'.
scenes.animation: Cards carry across columns one at a time (350ms ease-in-out); clock numerals roll; sunrise = background field switches lavender via a 0.5s wipe.
scenes.camera: Locked-off board, then a vertical tilt down to the phone on a bedside table.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.

scenes.voiceover: Profiles each have a job. Ada does errands, Milo watches money, Juno writes.
scenes.layout: Three real profile screens side by side: Ada (Errands, itinerary), Milo (Money, a bar list), Juno (Writing, a document). Names large above each.
scenes.elements: Three real profile screens side by side: Ada (Errands, itinerary), Milo (Money, a bar list), Juno (Writing, a document). Names large above each.
scenes.animation: Orbit-free: screens rise at different depths (Z hierarchy), the named one scales 1.06 and others dim to 70 percent in turn.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in 1.1x on the active screen.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.

scenes.voiceover: You set the limit, and see every step.
scenes.layout: Left: spend limit meter 38 of 50 euros. Right: step log with times and ticks.
scenes.elements: Left: spend limit meter 38 of 50 euros. Right: step log with times and ticks.
scenes.animation: Meter fills 0.9s ease-out; log rows type in with 120ms stagger.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
scenes.transitionOut: Rows scroll off to a parcel icon list.

scenes.layout: Skills list with 'New this week' rows; Memory and profiles rows beside them keep a green tick.
scenes.elements: Skills list with 'New this week' rows; Memory and profiles rows beside them keep a green tick.
scenes.animation: Rows drop in 80ms stagger; ticks pop on old rows.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
scenes.transitionOut: Rows collapse toward the centre mark.

scenes.voiceover: Headmaster. Your AI staff, always on.
scenes.onScreenText: Headmaster. Your AI staff, always on.
scenes.layout: Blue agent character small above the wordmark on lavender; URL below. Hold 2s.
scenes.elements: Blue agent character small above the wordmark on lavender; URL below. Hold 2s.
scenes.animation: Agent hops once (spring 0.5s), wordmark rises from a mask, URL fades in last.
scenes.lighting: Flat, even studio light. Depth only from opaque surfaces on lavender and hairline borders.
